headlines.title: 加皇银行：欧洲债券战术性做多的风险回报日益改善
headlines.summary: 加拿大皇家银行资本市场部分析师在一份报告中表示，尽管能源价格进一步上涨的风险依然存在，但战术性做多欧洲政府债券的风险回报比已有所改善。分析师称：“无论能源价格从当前水平进一步飙升（例如地缘政治局势升级），还是因局势缓和而再度回落，都可以设想债券市场从当前水平出现一轮战术性反弹。”加拿大皇家银行资本市场部长期以来一直看空债券市场，该行认为，支撑当前收益率水平的结构性背景并未改变。“不过，从战术层面看，我们认为市场仍可能进一步修正。面对加息预期升温和债券收益率高企，经济活动未来能够保持多大韧性，仍有待观察。”

headlines.title_en: RBC: Risk-reward for tactical long positions in European bonds is increasingly improving
headlines.summary_en: RBC Capital Markets analysts said in a report that although the risk of further energy price increases remains, the risk-reward ratio for tactically going long European government bonds has improved. "Whether energy prices spike further from current levels (for example, due to an escalation in geopolitical tensions) or fall back again on easing tensions, one can envisage a tactical rebound in the bond market from current levels," the analysts said. RBC Capital Markets has long been bearish on the bond market and believes the structural backdrop supporting current yield levels has not changed. "However, tactically, we believe the market could still correct further. It remains to be seen how resilient economic activity can remain in the face of rising rate-hike expectations and high bond yields."

headlines.title_en: Morning news roundup
headlines.summary_en: The ChiNext Index rose more than 3% in the morning session, with more than 4,800 stocks across the market gaining, and some broad-based ETFs saw significant increases in volume. The Hang Seng Index rose 0.61% in the morning session, the Hang Seng Tech Index rose 2.85%, and MINIMAX and Horizon Robotics rose more than 8%. Asian stocks rebounded from lows, with South Korea's KOSPI up 3% intraday; international oil prices fell 3%. Kioxia's profit guidance for this quarter missed expectations, and its shares fell about 15% at one point. China's October RatingDog manufacturing PMI was 52, expanding for an 11th consecutive month, with output growth hitting a six-month high. Multiple broad-based ETFs in China recorded record inflows in October. On Friday, margin financing balances in the Shanghai and Shenzhen markets fell by RMB 41.34 billion.

headlines.title_en: A-share close: ChiNext Index rebounds 1.87%, AI comic-drama concept surges across the board
headlines.summary_en: 1. The market opened higher and rose throughout the day, with all three major indices rebounding. AI comic-drama concept stocks surged across the board, with Mango Excellent Media, Haikan Co., Guomai Culture, Jebsen and many other stocks hitting the daily limit. Gaming stocks strengthened collectively, with Dasheng Culture, Youzu Interactive, Dianhun Network, Giant Network and others hitting the limit. Consumer stocks such as baijiu extended gains, with Qingdao Food posting a sixth consecutive limit-up, while Huangtai Liquor, Swellfun, Jinsheng Liquor and others hit the limit. Large financial stocks rallied, with Sinolink Securities, Pacific Securities, Yinzhijie, Hundsun Technologies and others hitting the limit. On the downside, the precious metals sector fell against the trend, with Shanjin International down more than 6%. Stocks rose broadly, with nearly 4,700 shares in the Shanghai, Shenzhen and Beijing markets gaining and more than 100 hitting the daily limit, with turnover today at RMB 1.8 trillion. As of the close, the Shanghai Composite rose 1.08%, the Shenzhen Component rose 1.63%, and the ChiNext Index rose 1.87%. 2. By sector and concept, AI comic-drama, gaming, major consumer and large financial sectors led gains.

headlines.title: 香港证监会公布首份AI准备情况调查
headlines.summary: 11月2日，香港证券及期货事务监察委员会（以下简称香港证监会）公布其首份《大型机构人工智能应用及准备情况调查》，结果显示机构已将人工智能（AI）广泛应用于业务及监控职能，但指出以负责任的方式扩展应用规模正面对挑战。本次调查于2026年7月至8月进行，涵盖20家大型金融机构及其78家香港联属持牌法团，覆盖今年上半年证券市场交易的75%。调查发现，全部受访机构均已运用AI；95%预期未来一年会加快AI应用；90%受访机构反映已运用或评估AI防范网络攻击风险；55%机构正运用或正在试用代理式AI。(中国基金报)

headlines.title_en: Hong Kong SFC publishes first AI preparedness survey
headlines.summary_en: On November 2, the Securities and Futures Commission of Hong Kong (HK SFC) published its first "Survey on the Use and Preparedness of Artificial Intelligence by Large Institutions," which found that institutions have widely adopted artificial intelligence (AI) across business and monitoring functions, but noted challenges in scaling adoption responsibly. The survey, conducted from July to August 2026, covered 20 large financial institutions and their 78 affiliated licensed corporations in Hong Kong, accounting for 75% of securities market trading in the first half of this year. It found that all surveyed institutions had adopted AI; 95% expected to accelerate AI adoption over the next year; 90% reported having used or evaluated AI to guard against cyberattack risks; and 55% were using or trialing agentic AI. (China Fund News)

headlines.title_en: A-share close: ChiNext Index stays strong all day, closing up 1.87%; film and cinema and AI application sectors lead gains
headlines.summary_en: Jinshi Data, November 2 - The A-share market opened higher and moved upward overall today, with a collective rally before the midday break pushing the ChiNext Index up over 3%, while index gains narrowed somewhat in the afternoon. As of the close, the Shanghai Composite rose 1.08%, the Shenzhen Component rose 1.63%, and the ChiNext Index rose 1.87%; turnover across the Shanghai and Shenzhen markets exceeded 1.7 trillion yuan, with more than 4,600 stocks across the market advancing. On the board, the AI application sector led the broader market, the film and cinema chain sector surged collectively, with multiple stocks such as Bona Film Group and China Television Media hitting the daily limit; the gaming and cultural media sectors ranked among the top gainers; the banking sector opened higher but closed lower, while the precious metals sector remained weak throughout the day.
